'''Yannick Lapointe why tie give you victory(the original)''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech. The description says: "I decide to put the real version of my 4 deck i have usei have play with this deck in day 2 i have won against james lafferty and steve brentsonand my friend maxim briand have play with my version and won against Martin Falke" (the description is cut off there; the event is not named). (posted 8 February 2000)<ref name="dt-3072">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3072 why tie give you victory(the original)], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 8 February 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3072/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3072/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018204838/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3072/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

=== Strategy ===

wait before giving me a half star and read if you dont understand dont review send me a message i explain in detail

you just have to put a tie everywhere wait and drain if he deploy imperial barier after that beetdownfor victory if you expect sense or frozen asset then put more than 1 tie you got big drain with this deck if your afraid of opps you got bright center you cancel 2 drain with u3po and starfleet + counter assault this deck is pretty easy to play and have no weekness if you play well and if you wondering why i dont have security precaution?? well you dont need it against space you dont spreed your fleet you wait ubtil he deploy than fight lateral damage+40power+first strike = victory so you dont need the damage of sp sorry for my english and have fun killing people
